svg.metadata: {"id": "s046", "name": "火山地质剖面", "cat": "科学", "tags": ["科学", "地球", "火山", "地理"], "desc": "火山地质剖面：上方是喷发的层状火山与灰云，地面以下切开可见彩色沉积岩层、化石、岩浆房与火山通道，左侧平地可站人讲解。", "stand": {"ground_y": 640, "x": [180, 880]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "far", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "cone", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "village", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "strata", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "magma", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "magma_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "lava", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "ash_cloud", "enter": "grow", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "lava_bombs", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#F9CFB0", "sky2": "#FFF1DE", "far": "#EBC9B1", "far2": "#E2B9A0", "smoke": "#A79AAE", "smoke2": "#D6CCD8", "ash": "#8E8296", "cone1": "#8C6858", "cone2": "#A6826E", "cone3": "#735447", "lava": "#FF7A3D", "lava2": "#FFC04D", "magma": "#E5432C", "magma2": "#FF9A3D", "grass": "#9ACB7A", "grass2": "#7DB463", "soil": "#9D7152", "l1": "#E2BB8C", "l2": "#CB9763", "l3": "#EFD3A6", "l4": "#B5835E", "l5": "#93694F", "l6": "#7A584A", "peb": "#F3E2C6", "fossil": "#FFF2DC", "tree": "#5FA36E", "tree2": "#8CCB80", "trunk": "#7A5238", "house": "#FFFFFF", "roof": "#E2584A", "glow": "#FFB347"}}
